benchmark_source.methodology: Thirty-six synthetic routing packets in eighteen one-field contrast sets, balanced across six execution policies. Cases are inspired by media catalog, computer-use, home-automation, software, and knowledge-work failure modes. The screen tests whether a router notices the constraint that changes the cheapest safe policy; it does not measure downstream task completion.
